routes.name: Visa-free entry for African passports
routes.summary: Per the official eVisa portal, Africans with a valid passport can enter without a visa for up to 30 days. You still fill in the online immigration form at least 24 hours before arrival.

other: The page says 'all African nationals'. Check the exempt-country list on voyage.gouv.tg for your passport.

routes.name: Togo eVisa
routes.summary: Visitors who need a visa apply online on the official portal. Visas are no longer issued on arrival. Validity runs 1 to 90 days.

other: Yellow fever vaccination card may be required
Apply at least 5 to 7 working days before arrival and no more than 90 days ahead

stay.note: Validity is 1 to 90 days based on stay length

documents: Optional: accommodation proof and return ticket
routes.processing: About 5 working days. An express option costs double the normal fee.

routes.name: Airport transit
routes.summary: No visa if you stay in the airport transit area. If you leave the airport, you need a visa approved before you arrive.

routes.name: Residence permit (carte de sejour)
routes.summary: Foreigners who settle in Togo need a residence permit. It comes in 1 year, 3 year and 5 year versions.

other: Clean criminal record and medical certificate
Employees need a hiring authorization and contract
Self-employed need a business registration card

documents: Passport copy valid 3+ months past permit
steps: Submit documents in person at the DGDN in Lome

routes.name: Naturalization
routes.summary: You need 5 years of habitual residence before applying, plus age 21 and good conduct. The page also lists renouncing your original nationality. Apply in person at the Tribunal de Lome.

other: Habitual residence in Togo for the 5 years before filing

documents: Request to the Minister of Justice with 1,000 FCFA stamp

citizenship.note: Page lists renouncing original nationality as a condition. Dual citizenship rules not confirmed.
